manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {3}{G}{G} if Germination Practicum is in your hand
description:
If Germination Practicum is in your hand, cast Germination Practicum by paying {3}{G}{G}. Otherwise, at the beginning of your precombat main phase, choose to cast a copy of it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Naru Meha by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Germination Practicum.
Resolve the copy of Germination Practicum, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Germination Practicum
uses.cardState: exiled on a previous turn by its paradigm ability
